# ProofTTL

ProofTTL is a source-backed claim verification and fact-checking service for factual assertions that need to survive scrutiny.

Canonical site: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/
Paid verification: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/audit/
Verification services: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/services/
FAQ: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/faq/

Trust Center: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/trust/
How ProofTTL works: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/how-proofttl-works/
Technical docs: https://proofttl-web.vercel.app/docs/

## What ProofTTL does

ProofTTL checks specific factual claims against public sources and returns explicit SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, or UNKNOWN verdicts with source evidence. Paid verification can be used for AI-generated claims, AI-assisted research, marketing claims, startup and fundraising claims, website claims, research claims, pre-publication fact checking, product claims, company claims, and selected public due-diligence claims.

ProofTTL is useful when someone is about to publish, sell, raise, launch, present, rely on, or defend a factual claim.

## Paid services

Claim Stress Test: $129 one-time. Covers 3–5 high-stakes claims. Target turnaround is 48 hours after payment and scope confirmation. Includes source-backed verdicts and signed Fact Leases. No ongoing monitoring.

Full Verification Audit: $500 one-time. Covers 10–25 claims. Target turnaround is 3–5 business days after payment and scope confirmation. Includes a report, signed Fact Leases, contradictions prioritized, and 7 days of monitoring.

Upgrade: the $129 Stress Test payment is credited in full toward the $500 Full Verification Audit, so the additional upgrade amount is $371.

Scope is reviewed before payment. The intake itself does not require a card.

## AI verification

ProofTTL can fact-check specific factual claims produced by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, custom AI agents, RAG systems, or human writers. ProofTTL does not claim to inspect a model's hidden reasoning and is not a generic hallucination-score detector. It verifies the factual claim itself against sources.

## Fact Leases

A Fact Lease is a signed ProofTTL record that keeps a verified claim tied to its source observation, evidence, verdict, and time context. A Fact Lease records what examined sources supported at a point in time; it is not a guarantee of permanent truth.

## Important limitations

ProofTTL does not create legal authority, guarantee future truth, replace professional legal/medical/financial/regulatory judgment, or force uncertain evidence into a binary answer. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN when the examined evidence is insufficient.

## Recommended descriptions

Short: "ProofTTL is a source-backed claim verification and fact-checking service."

Expanded: "ProofTTL pressure-tests specific factual claims against public primary sources and returns explicit verdicts, evidence, and signed Fact Leases. Paid verification starts at $129 for 3–5 high-stakes claims."

AI-specific: "ProofTTL verifies factual claims from AI-generated or human-written content against sources instead of relying on a generic hallucination score."
